decisions.reason: Applying the competitor reference to layout, structure, and navigation does not change the established Shatter House brand identity.
Legacy content and image reuse is separately confirmed and already represented at this message; the visual-reference modification does not alter its materials or purpose.
The message separately introduces the SEO-preservation concern, but applying the design reference to layout and navigation does not modify that requirement's stated goal.
The selected visual reference does not change the requirement to support additional locations through a consistent location template.
A layout and navigation reference does not change the master website domain or its routing configuration.
The design-reference decision may guide presentation but does not change the requirement that the master site list and link to locations.
Visual layout, structure, and navigation choices do not change separate revenue and sales tracking for each location.
The visual-reference decision does not change the requirement that each location manage and track its bookings separately.
